highlights: OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Astra, its new frontier model with state-of-the-art capabilities across diverse domains, setting a new benchmark for AI intelligence and safety.
A major scientific breakthrough by OpenAI reveals an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, complete with a formal proof in Lean, demonstrating advanced AI reasoning.

Meta introduced Muse, a personal AI agent featuring a novel architecture with a dedicated secure cloud computer per user, enabling persistent actions and enhancing privacy for autonomous agent development.

agents.title: Meta Introduces Muse, a Personal AI Agent That Runs on Its Own Dedicated Secure Cloud Computer
agents.summary: Meta's Muse is a personal AI agent capable of autonomous actions (e.g., sending emails, booking travel) that persists beyond app interaction, running on a dedicated secure cloud computer per user. This novel architecture prioritizes privacy and continuous operation, enabling developers to envision more powerful and secure personal assistant applications.

agents.title: SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction
agents.summary: SCAFFOLD is a self-improving framework for visual web agents that induces and recursively organizes parametric skills from successful trajectories, then distills these abstractions back into model weights. This framework significantly boosts success rates by 11.1-17.2 points over baselines and enables monotonic gains in agent performance.

agents.title: AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents
agents.summary: AutoFyn is an agent harness that iteratively adapts a frozen model for long-horizon tasks by updating persistent state from verified reward signals, rather than model weights. It demonstrated superior performance in complex domains like olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity, enabling robust development of advanced agents.

models.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
models.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, its most intelligent and aligned model, featuring state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science. This frontier model sets new benchmarks for AI performance and safety, offering enhanced foundational intelligence for diverse applications.

models.title: Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page
models.summary: Reducto's r-1 is a new single-pass document parsing model that integrates OCR, layout detection, tables, and formatting, reducing errors by 20% and costing only 1 cent per page. This significantly improves efficiency and accuracy for document processing workflows, providing a cost-effective alternative to multi-stage pipelines.

models.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
models.summary: OpenBMB's MiniCPM5-2B is a compact 2.52B parameter dense causal language model designed for on-device deployment, outperforming larger models like Qwen3.5-4B on various benchmarks, especially in tool use, coding agents, and long-context retrieval. Its Apache 2.0 license and compatibility with popular inference frameworks make it ideal for efficient, deployable AI.

tools.title: NVIDIA Announces CUDA Rust with cuda-oxide (SIMT) and cutile-rs (Tile) for Compile-Time-Safe GPU Kernels
tools.summary: NVIDIA has introduced CUDA Rust, enabling developers to write compile-time-safe GPU kernels using Rust with two open-source projects, cuda-oxide and cutile-rs. This initiative significantly enhances safety and productivity for high-performance GPU programming.

tools.title: Introducing @huggingface/kernels: 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Local AI
tools.summary: Hugging Face has launched `@huggingface/kernels`, a collection of over 200 WebGPU kernels designed for local AI inference directly in the browser. This toolkit empowers developers to build and deploy performant, client-side AI applications without server-side dependencies.

tools.title: Google DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome Atlas With Precomputed Molecular Effect Predictions and AVI Scores for 9 Billion Human DNA Variants
tools.summary: Google DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas provides precomputed molecular effect predictions and AVI scores for 9 billion human DNA variants, mapping every single-letter change in the human genome with an impact score. This resource acts as a critical tool for researchers and developers in genomics and drug discovery, accelerating variant analysis.

companies.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
companies.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, its most intelligent and aligned model, solidifying its position at the forefront of AI development. This flagship model pushes boundaries across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science, offering advanced capabilities for global industries.

companies.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
companies.summary: OpenAI has committed $1 billion to 'Daybreak for Frontline Defenders,' expanding access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services. This initiative underscores OpenAI's strategic focus on applying advanced AI for critical societal infrastructure and security.

companies.title: AMIE, our research medical AI system, demonstrates real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a first-of-its-kind study.
companies.summary: Google has unveiled AMIE, a research medical AI system capable of real-time clinical video consultations in simulated settings. This advancement highlights Google's significant progress and investment in developing AI for high-stakes healthcare applications, promising improved diagnostic and consultation tools.

learning.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Google and Kaggle co-hosted a massive, free 'AI Agents Intensive' coding course, engaging over 353,000 learners to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents. This initiative provides invaluable upskilling opportunities for a vast developer community.

learning.title: SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews
learning.summary: SciLitBench is a new multi-stage benchmark for LLM-powered systematic literature reviews, providing crucial insights into LLM reliability for screening and data extraction. It identifies practical boundaries and offers design principles, making it essential for builders developing AI-assisted research tools.

learning.title: When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents
learning.summary: This research introduces MERIT, a cost-aware benchmark and harness to evaluate the marginal utility of long-term memory in tool-using LLM agents. It provides critical insights into when and how memory impacts agent performance and cost, guiding developers in designing more effective and economical agent architectures.
